sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: On a forbidden Aegean island, a Foundation squad came to contain a living myth.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Only one soldier survived — fleeing with a cursed four-pixel photo clenched in his fist.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: From the ruined shrine of Athena, Medusa glided out and froze him mid-scream.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Seconds later, an unearthly shriek crossed the sea, and SCP Zero Nine Six smashed through the temple gate.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Its target was already marble — until Medusa looked straight into the monster's face.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Both curses ignited at once, and Zero Nine Six blurred across the courtyard like a missile.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Medusa fired a petrifying beam, then backflipped skyward a split-second before its claws struck.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Her vipers spat venom from above, yet Zero Nine Six ducked the volley and leaped off a broken column.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Medusa dove with brazen claws, slicing deep across its ribs before the monster caught her mid-air.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It yanked the cursed Gorgon out of the sky and slammed her into the marble floor.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Her golden wings shattered, Medusa stopped dodging and poured her entire curse into one gaze.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Emerald fire swallowed the shriek, locking pale flesh into solid rock from the eyes down.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Breathing hard among the rubble, Medusa turned her back on her deadliest trophy.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: But she had seen its face — and stone did not stop Zero Nine Six.
